concepts.def: Biotic = living components (plants, animals, fungi); abiotic = non-living (water, soil, climate, light).
Network of feeding relationships showing energy transfer: producers, primary consumers, secondary consumers, decomposers.
Movement of nutrients between biomass, soil, litter; rainforests rely on rapid recycling due to poor soils.
Vertical layers: emergent (50m+), canopy (30-45m), under-canopy, shrub layer, forest floor; each with adapted species.
Around 17% of Amazon lost since 1970s; causes include cattle ranching (80%), soy, logging, mining, road-building.
Use that meets present needs without compromising future; e.g. selective logging, ecotourism, FSC certification, debt-for-nature swaps.
